## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 210 captures during June 2024. Capture activity proceeded as planned, with session lists maintained apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that the clinic continued to provide regular image capture during the month. No operational issues affecting the reported capture total were identified.

## Image quality

Of the 210 captures, 5 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.4%. The ungradable images were excluded from grading outcomes. Image quality should continue to be monitored through routine review, with attention given to any recurring factors that may affect the ability to grade captures.

## Grading

Grading identified 49 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 5. This measure provides an overview of the interval between image capture and completion of grading during June 2024. Overall, the reported activity, image quality, and grading results provide the basis for routine service monitoring at Central Eye Clinic.
